svg.title: Blue Yellow Red IV
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Three observed horizontal joined panels: blue above yellow above red. Seams retained by separate vector elements; surface texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, yellow, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/blue-yellow-red-iv; object B-KELLY-2P81.10; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
